title: Chedariponi Nee Prema – John Wesly Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నా బంధువై నా గమ్యమై – నడిపావు ప్రతి బాటలో
బలియాగమై ఆ సిలువలో – తుడిచావు నా పాపము
శిధిలమైన నా బ్రతుకును – ఆనంద తైలముతో అభిషేకించావు
english: Naa bandhuwai naa gamyamai – nadipaavu prathi baatalo
Baliyaagamai aa siluvalo – thudichaavu naa paapamu
Sidhilamaina naa brathukunu – aananda thailamutho abhishekinchinaavu
Keerthincha kunda nenu undalenu – maarani prema naatho undaga

credits.Vocals: Dr John Wesly, Blessie Wesly & Dhanya Tryphosa

intro: Chedariponi Nee Prema is the latest Christian Telugu worship song written by Dr John Wesly, sung by Dr John Wesly, Blessie Wesly & Dhanya Tryphosa and music composed by John Pradeep. This song was released on November 07, 2025 through John Wesly Ministries YouTube channel.
